items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I got in contact with 'Bish' the next day and he was free and willing to join me... We opened the Rex and the band sounded better than before, because Bishop had more experience on drums

ctx.x: We had played the Jazz club of Luzern the 12th of April and coming back to Bern which was still our jumping off point in Switzerland, I told the fellows that we would play the Rex starting the 16th. Georgie Smith said that he was not going unless he saw my contract. I thought he was kidding because he or anyone else had never said anything like that to me and I had never heard any musician ask the leader to let him see his contract. I ask him what did he mean and he said: 'Put the contract on the table,' which…

I can be just as stubborn as anyone else if the occasion calls for being that way and I told Georgie that my decision had not changed either and that it had been nice knowing him. I knew that Wallace Bishop was in Basel, Switzerland and had heard that he was not working. So I got in contact with 'Bish' the next day and he was free and willing to join me. We opened the Rex and the band sounded better than before, because Bishop had more experience on drums than Georgie Smith, which gave us a different inspiration.…

One day, the manager of the Rex came to me and told me that one of the musicians had come to his office and asked to see the contract. Here we go again. I asked him what did he do and he said that he had let the musician see it. I was mad as hell and told the manager that he should not have done that because my contract with him was a personal matter between he and I, and was no concern of my musicians. He seemed surprised that I had taken that attitude but I made him understand that I was the one that did…
